mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COUNT(DISTINCT client_code) AS activeClients, 0 AS successRate FROM platform_api_access_stat WHERE called_at >= #{from} AND called_at < #{to}

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(called_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') AS bucket
DATE_FORMAT(called_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket
DATE_FORMAT(called_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS bucket
, COUNT(1) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount FROM platform_api_access_stat WHERE called_at >= #{from} AND called_at < #{to}
AND client_code = #{clientCode}
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC
